exact_falsifiable_hypothesis: Fetch plus git-show at an immutable commit detects branch-tip movement and preserves exact artifact bytes.

current_method_hypotheses.hypothesis: If a dedicated remote-tracking ref first resolves to pinned commit A and its remote branch is force-moved to unrelated commit B, a forced fetch will update the tracking ref to B; comparing the recorded A, pre-fetch ref and post-fetch ref will detect the movement.
current_method_hypotheses.independent_variable: Remote branch remains at A versus a forced non-fast-forward move from A to unrelated B.
current_method_hypotheses.falsifier: After the remote branch moves from A to B and fetch succeeds, the verifier reports no movement or does not resolve B as the post-fetch branch tip.

current_method_hypotheses.hypothesis: After that branch move, git show --no-textconv A:<path> will emit the original binary blob bytes rather than B:<path> bytes, and the emitted SHA-256 and byte count will equal the frozen artifact manifest.
current_method_hypotheses.independent_variable: Read object by immutable commit A instead of the moved mutable branch tip B.
current_method_hypotheses.falsifier: The pinned read differs by any byte or digest from A's frozen artifact, or it returns B's intentionally different artifact bytes.

conjunction_rule: H-PO03-WA-025 is SUPPORTED only if both frozen method hypotheses pass in the same sanitized reproduction; otherwise it is REFUTED or INCONCLUSIVE according to the observed failure.
